File separation An AUTOSAR model may be shipped in several AUTOSAR XML description files.
File Name Extension: .arxml AUTOSAR XML descriptions shall use the file extension ".arxml" (short for AUTOSAR XML).
File Name Length The maximum length of the filename is re- stricted to 255 characters.
UTF-8 Character Encoding The character encoding of AUTOSAR XML descriptions shall be UTF-8. No other encodings are allowed.
UTF-8 Encoding in XML Declaration AUTOSAR XML descrip- tions shall start with an XML declaration that declares UTF-8 encoding.
Avoid UTF BOM AUTOSAR XML descriptions should NOT start with a "UTF Byte Order Mask" (BOM).
XML Version 1.0 AUTOSAR XML descriptions shall conform to XML version 1.0 [8]. No other XML version is allowed.
XML Version 1.0 in XML Declaration AUTOSAR XML descrip- tions shall start with an XML declaration that declares XML version 1.0 [8].
XML Comments AUTOSAR XML descriptions may contain XML comments.
XML Processing Instructions An AUTOSAR XML description may contain XML processing instructions. 1
